title: Mandala Calm
subtitle: A Coloring Book for Adults
author: Your Name
back_blurb:
Unwind one page at a time. Inside you will find 40 original mandalas, from simple floral patterns to detailed ornamental designs, each printed on its own single-sided page so you can color with markers, gel pens or watercolors without worrying about bleed-through.

No experience needed. Just pick your favorite colors and enjoy a calm, creative break.
